title: Club Membership: how a payment is applied against the dues balance
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which a payment toward Club Membership dues is applied, and the duplicate-posting boundary that protects the member's dues balance.

## Rule
A payment is applied against the member's dues balance on the date it is received.

## Eligibility: no duplicate posting
The same payment must not be posted twice for the same membership contract at the same recorded moment. This check correlates to the specific membership contract the payment is applied against, and is based on the system's own record of prior payment entries for that contract; a payment record already on file for that membership contract, at that same recorded moment, is not posted a second time.

## Points of judgement
Two payments received for the same membership contract at genuinely different recorded moments are two separate, legitimate postings under this basis; only a repeat posting that shares both the same membership contract and the same recorded moment as an existing entry falls outside this basis.
